title: Sanctions Screening Alert-Economics Modeler
description: Models the annualized analyst-hours cost of a sanctions/AML screening program's alert volume and false-positive burden: cost per true positive and threshold-tuning sensitivity curve. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.

mcp_tool_definition.name: model_sanctions_alert_economics
mcp_tool_definition.description: Models the annualized cost of a sanctions/AML screening program's alert volume: computes alerts per year from screened volume and alert rate, analyst hours from an L1-triage plus L2-escalation tier split (each with its own handle time), annualized cost from a loaded analyst rate, true positives from the false-positive rate, and cost per true positive. Produces a threshold-tuning sensitivity curve (alert-rate deltas to cost deltas) and displays the OFAC IEEPA statutory maximum civil penalty (2026: USD 377,700 per violation) as a labelled context anchor never multiplied into the cost arithmetic. Companion to tool 517 (match-score calibration) for economics rather than matching logic. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/641-sanctions-alert-economics-modeler.html for interactive use.
